answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring every identity to anchor a refundable stake to one verified key and to earn its standing over a horizon of completed, checkable jobs rather than by claiming it at once. A newcomer starts on a narrow ledge: it may only take small, low-value tasks until its delivered work is attested by independent peers. Creating thousands of fake identities then costs thousands of separate stakes plus thousands of separate work histories, while a single honest agent keeps one growing record, so forgery scales in cost but never in advantage.
